outcome: coalescence of lymphoid follicles in spleen
embryo/fetal and neonatal growth and development
cohort: Pregnant Wistar rats (n=8, n=6 for control groups, n=9, n=8, n=9, n=7 for treated groups, and 5 for transplacental analysis) received L-mimosine or vehicle from gestational day 6-19.
finding: L-mimosine was detected in the amniotic fluid and exhibited dose-dependent toxic effects, including skeletal and visceral alterations in fetuses at lower doses, and severe maternal and fetal effects like immune system changes, enzyme alterations, and alopecia at higher doses, negatively impacting embryo/fetal and neonatal growth and development.
followup_time: N/A (observations were made on fetuses at gestational day 19, and effects on 'neonatal growth' were concluded but not directly measured post-birth in the described methods).
gest_age: Fetal analysis performed at gestational day 19.
